## 2025-02-27 - Unrestricted File Upload via Multer

**Vulnerability:** The `/api/upload` endpoint used `multer` without configured `fileSize` limits, making it susceptible to Denial of Service (DoS) attacks by uploading arbitrarily large files and exhausting disk space or memory. It also leaked exact internal error messages on processing failure.
**Learning:** Even internal or POC applications need basic payload limits on file upload handlers, and dynamically generated system error messages (like those generated by `pdf-parse`) must never be piped directly into client JSON responses.
**Prevention:** Always configure `limits.fileSize` when initializing `multer` and use standard, static error responses (or abstract error codes) instead of `error.message` for catch blocks handling external input.
